name: no-shell-edits
description: Stop Claude from editing files through Bash (sed -i, heredocs, echo >, tee, python -c) and point it to Edit/Write, so every change shows as a diff and /rewind can undo it.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: deny refuses the command and tells Claude to use Edit/Write; warn lets it run and adds that note to the result Claude reads.

blockReads.title: Block shell reads
blockReads.description: Also refuse cat/head/tail/less/more of a single file and tell Claude to use Read.

allowPaths.title: Allowed paths
allowPaths.description: Comma-separated globs the shell may write. A glob without / matches a file name anywhere (*.log); one with / matches from the project root (.git/**, dist/**). /dev is always allowed; /tmp, /var/folders and $TMPDIR are allowed outside the project.

statusLine.title: Status line count
statusLine.description: Pin 'no-shell-edits: N blocked' under the prompt once something was blocked.
